'''December 2000 Pleasanton tournament (first event)''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held in Pleasanton, California on 16 December 2000. [[Alfred Dong]] won it. It is known from Nick Stefanko's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d1554">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-12-17-pleasanton-ca-12-16-00d1554/ pleasanton-ca-12-16-00], DeckTech (Nick "JediBrain" Stefanko, 17 December 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-12-17-pleasanton-ca-12-16-00d1554/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 16 December 2000
* '''Site:''' Pleasanton, California
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Jabba's Palace Sealed Deck]]
* '''Players:''' 16
* '''Winner:''' [[Alfred Dong]]

== Tournament reports ==

Players' own reports from this event.

* [[Nick Stefanko Pleasanton CA 12-16-00 (tournament report)]] — by [[Nick Stefanko]], 7th, 3–3
* [[Alfred Dong Pleasonton CA Two In One 12-16 (tournament report)]] — by [[Alfred Dong]], 1st, 5–1

== Discrepancies ==

Where a source disagrees with the record on this page, the page keeps the record and notes the difference here.

* Nick Stefanko says Alfred Dong went undefeated and that Stefanko finished 7th; Dong's own report gives Dong 5–1 (loss to Mike Mendoza by 31) and lists Stefanko 4th.<ref name="tr-d1554" />
* Alfred Dong reports going 5–1 (lost to Mike Mendoza by 31) and lists Nick Stefanko 4th; Stefanko's report says Dong went undefeated and that Stefanko finished 7th.<ref name="tr-d1562" />
